newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper regains initiative on global trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper regains initiative on global trends.

text.p: Indian copper prices regained the initiative on Friday, after recent falls, on rising global prices, dealers said.
Other metals were quiet on limited activity.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 11,900 rupees per quintal on stray physical support and restricted offerings by state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd.
"Rising global prices dragged copper up," one dealer said.
Nickel and aluminium were unchanged. Zinc was steady at 6,325 rupees, lead at 5,000 rupees and tin at 35,900 rupees.
